title: Doug Wolf, first OGA director with NRO career

tellings.quote: Do you know Doug Wolf additionally spent 16 years in the NRO

plain: Doug Wolf, the first director of an office known by the letters OGA, had spent 16 years before that at the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this on Michels's show without giving a source. He raises it while laying out how he thinks the Pentagon's secret UFO program works, and the career link would tie that office to the world of spy satellites.
